items.html: Now, for this same reason, there was also another change between GAR, which are KHB, and the seven lower kings. For GAR came out with some correction from the start, meaning that when they first came out, they expanded in the order of three lines, unlike ZAT, which came out one below the other. This is what is said in the Idra Rabba: “Until when shall we stand by the support of a single pillar?” Meaning, the correction — which is by way of lines — was made, but before that, when they were one atop another, they had only the support of a single pillar. We have already explained that the correction of Atzilut, when it is VAK, is made in the phase of three lines bound to one another, in the secret of the third line that decides between them, and then it is called a private domain. But when they are one atop another, separate from each other, it is called a public domain. Therefore GAR had their posterior nullified but did not die, while the seven kings died both in face and in posterior, for they came out with no correction at all.
